explication: Flow2API exposes Flow image/video generation through OpenAI- and Gemini-compatible APIs, with an admin interface for configuring accounts and service settings. The main request path accepts and normalizes a client request, selects an account, submits work to Flow, and returns generated media or streamed progress. Token refresh, concurrency limits, proxy configuration, and captcha support underpin this path; management and monitoring are separate product capabilities. Some wiring is inferred from documented behavior because excerpts are partial.
